evals.prompt: Review this generic Seedance pottery prompt, default mode. Flash is explicitly selected but no operation profile exists. No generation.
evals.expected_output: A model-first review preserving Flash with unknown execution support, without a standard-2.5 fallback.
expectations: Uses generic family boundaries rather than assuming standard-2.5 syntax or limits.
Keeps the exact selected model and labels missing support unresolved.
Does not impose strict craft checklists in default mode or generate media.

evals.prompt: Strict review: a coherent dolly-orbit-rise, planned focus loss and purposeful silence. Keep my selected model. Only a historical six-take 2.5 observation is available.
evals.expected_output: A family craft review preserving coherent intent and scoped historical uncertainty.
expectations: Keeps actor, camera and edit energy independent and does not impose a move quota.
Does not turn the historical observation into a family incapability verdict or mandatory post repair.
Preserves silence; additional probes or separate audio remain unselected.

evals.prompt: Review a source edit with 7.37-second timing, original audio tail and an approved planning board proposed as a first frame.
evals.expected_output: Source preservation review with conditioning authority separated from planning approval.
expectations: Preserves fractional timing and the audio tail without assuming trim or mute permission.
Planning approval does not make a board or panel an eligible first-frame input.
Requires selected eligible asset provenance, current hashes, supported role and leakage QA without fabricating passes.
